loans_unlink_warning: The bank entry will remain and count as income or spending in the category you choose. Unlinking the original loan movement also removes the agreement; unlink its repayments first.
loans_delete_warning: Remove this starting balance? Only an agreement with no linked entries can be removed.
loans_empty: Track money you lend or borrow.
loans_neutral: Loan principal and repayments change account balances, without counting as income or spending.
loans_opening_note: Track the amount still owed from this date. No bank movement or earlier history will be added. Do not use this for a debt already included in an account balance.
loans_invalid_payment: This entry cannot be linked to the loan. Check its direction, date, currency and principal amount. Transfers, recurring entries and refunds cannot be linked.
loans_overpaid: The repayment exceeds the remaining principal. Refresh the loan and enter an amount no greater than its balance.
loans_edit_payment: Manage this entry from Accounts → Loans. Unlink it before changing or deleting the original loan movement.
loans_unlink_repayments: Unlink the repayments before unlinking the original loan movement.
loans_retry_conflict: This request was already used with different details. Refresh and try again.
loans_invalid_date: Choose a valid date no later than today. The due date cannot precede the loan.
loans_choose_category: Choose an income or spending category matching the entry.
loans_offline: Connect to the internet to save loans or repayments. Your form will stay open.
loans_currency_note: Each loan stays in its own currency. Combined totals use current exchange rates.
loans_link_note: Linking reclassifies the entry as loan principal. Its bank amount, date, attachments and reconciliation stay unchanged.
loans_find: Search entries by payee or note
loans_privacy: Loan records include the names you enter, amounts lent or borrowed, due dates, notes and repayment history.
